title: How Do You Evaluate Content Value on Steem?
body: On Steem, content valuation happens through a combination of community curation and algorithmic mechanisms. When you upvote a post, you're allocating a portion of your voting power to signal content quality. But what makes content valuable? Is it technical depth, entertainment value, community engagement, or educational utility? Different communities within Steem may prioritize different aspects of content. The curation rewards system incentivizes careful evaluation, as successful curators share in the rewards of high-quality content they identify early. How do you approach content curation? Do you focus on specific topics, emerging creators, or established voices? What metrics do you find most reliable for identifying valuable contributions to the ecosystem?
